Gunned down after turning life around

Marsha Dean Published 2 hours ago

The 23-year-old victim, known as Darren, was shot dead at around 5.30pm after sustaining a gunshot wound to the head.

The murder occurred in Bonteheuwel near the train station. Police said no arrests have been made.

Local ward councillor Angus McKenzie has extended a heartfelt appeal to anyone who may have any information about the shooting incident to come forward.
